name: footer-local-business
title: Local business footer
description: A footer for a shop, practice or tradesperson: address, phone, today's opening hours, a route button and the registration line.
docs: address is an array of lines, set in a real address element with the phone and the email, whose links carry the number and the address as their own text; phoneHref sets another tel: address for a number with an extension. hours takes the shape OpeningHours takes: the days, today's index and the open-now line, which you work out in the business's time zone. The footer draws the week itself, so its heading, the word read out after today and the word for a closed day are all in labels. routeHref opens in a new tab and says so; routeNote adds a line beside the button and map takes a static map image or a drawing, which is hidden from assistive technology, so put nothing in it a visitor needs. registration lists the numbers a Dutch or German site shows, such as KvK, BTW, HRB or USt-IdNr., as a definition list in the legal row. labels translates the headings, the words of the hours and the route button, and linkAs renders your router's Link.
